name: aspect-ratio
useFor: Wrap a screenshot, an attachment preview or a video in AspectRatio with ratio={16 / 9} (or 4 / 3, 1) so it keeps its shape at every width. Round and clip it with rounded-control and overflow-hidden.
constraints: Stretching an image to fill without object-cover
Corners other than the card's 8px on media inside cards
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the 8px corners of its cards and wells
title: Aspect Ratio
description: A frame that holds media at a fixed shape.
